Country reference data — the ISO 3166 lists the address contract validates against. UNAUTHENTICATED, because hosted checkout and the customer portal render the same address form under a short-lived buyer token rather than an org API key. Cacheable for a day.

## Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | [`/v1/countries`](/help/developers/api-reference/reference/list-every-country) | List every country |
| `GET` | [`/v1/countries/{code}`](/help/developers/api-reference/reference/get-one-country-by-iso-3166-1-alpha-2-code) | Get one country by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code |
| `GET` | [`/v1/countries/{code}/subdivisions`](/help/developers/api-reference/reference/list-a-country-s-subdivisions) | List a country’s subdivisions |
